tools.name: trnch_check
tools.description: Free, no key, no wallet: check any Robinhood Chain token before you buy it. Rug, honeypot, scam or copycat? Returns { verified, summary, status, category, rugged, dumped, copyOf, tokenUrl, cardUrl }: summary is a one-line verdict ready to post, copyOf { symbol, officialAddress, kind? } is set for a

tools.name: trnch_scan_wallet
tools.description: Free, no key: check every ERC-20 a Robinhood Chain wallet holds in one call. Returns { wallet, truncated, checked, flaggedCount, tokens }: each token has address, symbol, balance { raw, decimals }, valueUsd when known, the same Trnch verdict as trnch_check { status, category, rugged, dumped }, creat

tools.name: trnch_top_24h
tools.description: Free, no key: what performed on Robinhood Chain in the last 24 hours: the best tokens that entered the Trnch Heat (new tokens screened by Trnch), with their peak and current multiple since entry, and a link to trade them at the best route. Rugged, dumped and flagged tokens are left out. Past perform

tools.name: trnch_stats
tools.description: Free, no key: read live public numbers for the last 24 hours: tokens spotted, tokens in the Heat, tokens kept out as High risk, rugs detected, median detection delay in seconds, number of routers and the bot fee in percent.

tools.name: trnch_quote
tools.description: Free, no key, no wallet: quote any pair across eight routers (KyberSwap, LI.FI, Uniswap, 0x, SushiSwap, 1inch, Velora, Nordstern) without building a transaction. Returns the best amount out, already net of the Trnch fee, the router and the fee rate in basis points (feeBps). Covers the official Stock

tools.name: trnch_register_message
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 to get an API key for trading, no browser. Returns { message }: the exact text your wallet must sign with personal_sign (EIP-191). It is valid for 10 minutes and moves no funds.

tools.name: trnch_register
tools.description: Step 2 of 2: send the message returned in step 1 and its signature; returns { key, prefix, wallet } with status 201. The key is shown once, store it. 3 keys max per wallet (409); up to 10 new keys per IP per day; 120 calls per minute per IP across keys; 400 if the message expired or was altered, 401

tools.name: trnch_heat
tools.description: Read the live Heat: heat holds tokens screened by Trnch and ranked by Heat score; new holds just-spotted tokens not yet screened (higher risk). Each token is an opaque id with rank, Heat score, price, liquidity, volume, price changes and entry time. Returns nextSince: pass it back as since to get on

tools.name: trnch_buy
tools.description: Build a buy in one call: quotes eight routers and returns the best route as a transaction for the key's wallet to sign. Give tokenId or token, and amountUsd (paid in USDG) or amountIn with tokenIn. The Trnch fee (0.25% standard, 0.10% between major assets, 0.05% between a Stock Token and a major ass

tools.name: trnch_sell
tools.description: Build a sell for USDG in one call: give tokenId or token, and percent of the wallet balance (read on chain) or an exact amount. Quotes eight routers and returns the best route as a transaction to sign. The Trnch fee (0.25% standard, 0.10% between major assets, 0.05% between a Stock Token and a major

tools.name: trnch_confirm
tools.description: Optional, after sending a swap transaction built by this server: report its hash so the volume is credited to the Trnch account of the key's wallet once the receipt is checked on chain. Returns an acknowledgement only; it does not send, cancel or change the transaction, and a hash that is not a swap

tools.name: trnch_alerts_subscribe
tools.description: Get a signed webhook POST when a token a wallet holds is newly flagged by Trnch. Give wallet (any address) and webhookUrl (https, a public domain name, port 443; IPs, localhost and private or internal names are refused). Each alert carries the token, the Trnch verdict { status, category, rugged, dum

tools.name: trnch_alerts_list
tools.description: List the wallet alert subscriptions of this key: id, wallet, webhook URL, failures in a row, disabled flag and lastDelivery (delivered or failed). The secret is never returned again. Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

tools.name: trnch_alerts_unsubscribe
tools.description: Remove one wallet alert subscription of this key by id (from trnch_alerts_list). 404 if it does not exist. Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

tools.name: trnch_partner_fee_get
tools.description: Read the default integrator fee of a Trnch partner. Returns { partner, bps, maxBps }: partner is the partner code, bps the default fee in basis points (0 to maxBps, 100). The default fee is added to the Trnch fee on swaps attributed to the partner and paid to the partner through the partner program;

tools.name: trnch_partner_fee_set
tools.description: Set the default integrator fee of a Trnch partner, an integer from 0 to 100 basis points. Returns { partner, bps, maxBps, previousBps }. Each change is recorded with its channel. 400 for a value out of range. Authentication: header X-Trnch-Partner-Key linked to a Trnch partner, or Authorization: Bea

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trnch_check, trnch_register_message, trnch_heat, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list · Private data: trnch_check, trnch_scan_wallet, trnch_top_24h, trnch_stats, trnch_quote, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_heat, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list, trnch_alerts_unsubscribe, trnch_partner_fee_get, trnch_partner_fee_set · Public sink: trnch_check, trnch_register, trnch_confirm, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list · Destructive: trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_unsubscribe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trnch_check, trnch_register_message, trnch_heat, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list · Private data: trnch_check, trnch_scan_wallet, trnch_top_24h, trnch_stats, trnch_quote, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_heat, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list, trnch_alerts_unsubscribe, trnch_partner_fee_get, trnch_partner_fee_set · Public sink: trnch_check, trnch_register, trnch_confirm, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list · Destructive: trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_unsubscribe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
